This role serves as a critical connective function across internal teams, ensuring stakeholders are aligned on priorities, dependencies, risks, decisions, and execution plans required to deliver data center capacity successfully. This leader will partner closely with Data Center Development, Design & Construction, Engineering, Power & Utilities, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Security, Network, Operations, Project Controls, and Executive Leadership to create a single operating rhythm across complex infrastructure programs. Establish clear communication channels, decision forums, escalation paths, and operating rhythms to keep stakeholders aligned across the full delivery lifecycle. Translate complex technical, commercial, operational, and financial inputs into clear, actionable plans and decision points for leadership. PMO Leadership & Operating Model Lead the Data Center Infrastructure PMO, including governance structure, program cadence, stakeholder engagement model, executive reporting rhythm, and delivery assurance mechanisms. Execute established PMO and Project Controls standards across the data center infrastructure portfolio, ensuring consistent adoption by program teams. Drive adherence to defined processes for milestone tracking, risk review, decision management, change governance, dependency management, and issue resolution. Coach the team on executive communication, cross-functional influence, issue resolution, and structured decision-making. Experience supporting large-scale data center, hyperscale, colocation, cloud, AI infrastructure, telecom, energy, or mission-critical infrastructure programs. Strong ability to influence without direct authority and drive accountability across matrixed organizations. Experience executing established portfolio governance, program reporting, delivery assurance, risk review, dependency management, decision tracking, and change governance processes. Proven ability to manage complex, multi-site, multi-stakeholder programs with significant capital, schedule, operational, and organizational dependencies. Experience creating executive-level reporting, steering committee materials, decision memos, and stakeholder communications. Strong financial and commercial acumen, including familiarity with CapEx planning, budget tracking, forecasting, procurement dependencies, and vendor-related risks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex program information for executive audiences.
